name: Intersection of Temple St. & Stone St.
desc1: The magnificent Temple of Silvermere stands tall and proud to your
desc2: west. It white silver-streaked marble walls are a testament to its
desc3: magnificent construction, as does the fact that it has remained
desc4: seemingly undamaged for the past hundred years. This is where weary
desc5: folk go to have their wounds healed, and where holy folk receive their
desc6: divine training. The Temple's large wrought doors are open to the
desc7: public at all hours. Stone street crosses to the north and south here.
